rationale_evidence.anchor: Not every knowledge object is naturally a measurable set. Not every epistemic attribute has additive measure semantics. Not every participant relation is probabilistic. Not every knowledge transition is continuous or differentiable. Not every comparison needs a metric. Knowledge itself is not a numerical quantity merely because some of its properties can be measured.
rationale_evidence.statement: Six reasons why KnowledgeOS should not be made a measure space: not every knowledge object is naturally a measurable set; not every epistemic attribute has additive measure semantics; not every participant relation is probabilistic; not every knowledge transition is continuous or differentiable; not every comparison needs a metric; and knowledge itself is not a numerical quantity merely because some of its properties can be measured.
